pages.title: Froggee
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Tap to send the frog upward in Froggee. Catch flies and pick up stars on your way past dangerous plants and animals. Jump into a bubble when you can reach one to fly higher.

pages.title: Planet Blast: Rockets
pages.creator: Prime Web Publish
pages.description: Design rockets and aim them at distant worlds in Planet Blast: Rockets. Balance fuel, mass, and explosive power before each launch. Upgrade the components as you unlock more planets to strike.

pages.title: Coin Blitz
pages.creator: LevelKraft Technologies
pages.description: Drag your shooter into position in Coin Blitz and fire through waves of enemies. Gather the coins that burst out and use your growing strength to hold off the next wave.

pages.title: Ancient Wars: Caesar
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Direct warriors, archers, and generals in Ancient Wars: Caesar. Manage resources and position your units for each fight, then push through the opposing troops to bring down their base.

pages.title: Elytra Flight
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Glide as far as you can in Elytra Flight. Read the route ahead and adjust your flight before a hazard cuts the attempt short. Fly solo or try the two-player mode.

pages.title: 3D Block Gladiator: Sword Draw
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Draw paths for your sword attacks and dodges in 3D Block Gladiator: Sword Draw. Watch the opponent's position and sketch a move that lets your gladiator strike without taking the hit.

pages.title: SquidGame.io
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Survive a series of minigames against rivals in SquidGame.io. Learn what each challenge asks of you and react in time to avoid elimination by the Pink Soldiers.

pages.title: Vortex io
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Swallow objects to grow in Vortex io. Start with what fits inside your vortex and work up to vehicles and other players as it expands. Keep clear of larger rivals.

pages.title: GTA: Grand Vegas Crime
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Explore a Las Vegas-inspired city in GTA: Grand Vegas Crime. Take on assignments, get through car chases, and face rival gangs and police as you move through the open world.

pages.title: Office Escape to Date
pages.creator: Briuor
pages.description: Get ready for a date before the workday timer runs out in Office Escape to Date. Close your preparations when the boss appears, then pick up where you left off.

pages.title: Sudo Tetroid Daily
pages.creator: Denda Games
pages.description: Fit numbered tetrominoes into the board in Sudo Tetroid Daily. Rotate each piece so the rows, columns, and boxes obey Sudoku rules. Try the daily layout for a fresh puzzle.

pages.title: Merry Christmas Stickman
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Choose items from a Christmas package in Merry Christmas Stickman. See how each choice changes the jailbreak and help Stickman find a route to freedom in time for the holidays.

pages.title: Shop Sorting Xmas
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Move toys and decorations around a holiday shop in Shop Sorting Xmas. Put three identical items together to clear them, leaving space to work with the goods still on the shelves.

pages.title: Squid Candy Challenge
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Cut the outline out of a candy in Squid Candy Challenge. Follow the shape carefully so it stays in one piece, and finish before the timer reaches zero.

pages.title: Crazy Hill Climbing
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Drive across rough climbs in Crazy Hill Climbing. Use coins to improve the tires, engine, or suspension, and try front or back flips for extra points when the terrain gives you room.

pages.title: Animal Link
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Connect tiles with the same animal picture in Animal Link. Clear matching pairs and check what becomes available after each connection until you've removed the whole layout.

pages.title: Beat Blader 3D
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Swing two energy blades to the beat in Beat Blader 3D. Slice the targets as they arrive and time your movement past the hazards that come with each song.

pages.title: Stack Battle.io
pages.creator: Ohayō
pages.description: Collect bricks and carry them back to your base in Stack Battle.io. Slide to steer as you stack materials, then put them to use in the tower-defense battle.

pages.title: Blockapolypse Zombie Shooter
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Watch three directions for enemies in Blockapolypse Zombie Shooter. Clear the waves and face the giant undead creature, then spend gold on stronger weapons if you have enough.

pages.title: Strawberry Shortcake
pages.creator: Tap Tap Tales
pages.description: Help Strawberry Shortcake follow her dream of baking in Big Apple City in Strawberry Shortcake. Click or swipe through the activities as she settles in with Aunt Praline and takes on baking tasks.

pages.title: Dot by Dot
pages.creator: Mamboo Games
pages.description: Connect the colored points in Dot by Dot to build a picture from lines. Finish linking the dots and watch the game fill in the colors to reveal your drawing.

pages.title: Hidden Object Great Journey
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Search themed scenes in Hidden Object Great Journey. Pick out the objects hidden in each setting and switch modes when you want a different kind of search.

pages.title: Cooking Frenzy
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Cook for customers before time runs out in Cooking Frenzy. Use the money from each round to decorate your restaurant and give the dining room the look you want.

pages.title: ChaseRace eSport Strategy Racing Game
pages.creator: ChaseRace K/S
pages.description: Plan your moves on the track in ChaseRace eSport Strategy Racing Game. Think ahead through turn-based multiplayer races and weigh up how each decision changes the contest.

pages.title: Ball Surfer 3D
pages.creator: Faramel Games
pages.description: Steer a rolling ball in Ball Surfer 3D. Dodge the obstacles and collect power-ups along the way, then use the points you earn to unlock other balls.

pages.title: Twerk Race 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pick up blocks to grow your runner in Twerk Race 3D. Choose a route around the obstacles and try to reach the end first. Try different skins as you play.

pages.title: Bubble Fall
pages.creator: SUN.STUDIO
pages.description: Pop colorful bubbles in Bubble Fall. Look at the arrangement before each move and work through the three-dimensional layouts as the puzzles introduce new challenges.

pages.title: Harvest Cut Master
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: Harvest a field in each level of Harvest Cut Master. Improve your equipment or buy another farm vehicle when you need to cut a different crop.

pages.title: Side Defense
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Switch between two defenses in Side Defense. Fire at falling red and yellow balls from the matching side and stop them before any reach the bottom.

pages.title: Help imposter escape
pages.creator: Flikes Games
pages.description: Help a stranded impostor find a way out in Help imposter escape. Work through 50 levels in the strange dimension and unlock new looks as you progress.

pages.title: Diamond Rush
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Gather diamonds for an engagement ring in Diamond Rush. Move around obstacles to keep the stones you've collected, then use your haul to create the ring.

pages.title: Idle Hero: Counter Terrorist
pages.creator: Hihoy
pages.description: Deploy soldiers in Idle Hero: Counter Terrorist. Decide how to spend your money on the lineup and adjust what you send when another group of enemies arrives.

pages.title: Christmas Crush
pages.creator: Bizogames.com
pages.description: Swipe to match three or more holiday items in Christmas Crush. Work toward the current mission and use boosters when they can clear an area you can't reach.

pages.title: Balls Throw Duel 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Aim balls at the centers of rings in Balls Throw Duel 3D. A ball scores when it stays in place, so adjust the next throw based on where the last one landed.

pages.title: Make 5 Hexa
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Rotate and place numbered hexagons in Make 5 Hexa. Look for a position that merges matching pieces, and leave enough room for another useful placement after the match.

pages.title: I love Hue
pages.creator: Gamesonline.co.id
pages.description: Restore smooth transitions between shades in I love Hue. Compare neighboring tiles and move the colors where they belong, paying attention to subtle changes as the gradient comes together.

pages.title: Century Gold Miner
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Search underground for gold and diamonds in Century Gold Miner. Work deeper into the mine and face the goblins and demons guarding the valuables you want to reach.

pages.title: Super Burger 2
pages.creator: Xlab Game Studio
pages.description: Fill orders at a burger counter in Super Burger 2. Check what each customer wants and get it ready on time. Try the different worlds for more burgers to make.

pages.title: Puzzle Game Boys
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Put nine pictures back together in Puzzle Game Boys. Move the pieces into place and use familiar shapes or colors to work out which sections join.

pages.title: Perfect Snipe Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Take on sniper missions in Perfect Snipe Online. Line up enemies from a distance and shoot the keys when you spot them. Work through each level's different setup.

pages.title: Nail Salon For Animals
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Welcome animal clients in Nail Salon For Animals. Work through the manicure activities and choose colors for their nails. See how each set looks when the salon visit is complete.

pages.title: Animal Life Cycle
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Explore how animals change as they grow in Animal Life Cycle. Look at the pictures and work out which stage belongs next in each animal's development.

pages.title: 123 Draw
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Practice writing digits in 123 Draw. Follow the shape of each number and draw over the guide, paying attention to the direction of the strokes as you work through the activity.

pages.title: Car Transporter Truck Simulator
pages.creator: Inspire Game Studio
pages.description: Haul cars between cities in Car Transporter Truck Simulator. Drive a heavy trailer with its load aboard and give the long vehicle room to turn on the way to the destination.

pages.title: MathPup Chase Multiplication
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Help a nervous dog by solving multiplication problems in MathPup Chase Multiplication. Get the answers right to chase away dogcatchers, vacuums, and other scares. Pick from three skill settings.

pages.title: Cute Penguin Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble six penguin pictures in Cute Penguin Puzzle. Choose 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, then look for the outlines and color patches that help the picture fit together.

pages.title: Princess Pet Treatment
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Rescue Clara's injured pet in Princess Pet Treatment. Work through the care steps, then help the princess choose an outfit after her pet has been treated.

pages.title: Wheel Smash
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Roll a wheel over objects in Wheel Smash. Choose where to move and see how the different hard and soft items break underneath it as you work through the course.

pages.title: Police Multi Level Car Parking
pages.creator: MaxZoon
pages.description: Take police cars through parking layouts in Police Multi Level Car Parking. Steer carefully around the lot and leave room for the last turn into each parking spot.

pages.title: American Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: Best Games
pages.description: Rebuild truck pictures in American Trucks Jigsaw. Select one of six images and a difficulty, then drag pieces into place using details in the bodywork and background.

pages.title: The Unique Fish
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Pick out the fish that doesn't match the others in The Unique Fish. Compare the pictures carefully and look for the detail that sets one swimmer apart from the rest.

pages.title: Match The Shapes
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Slide identical shapes together in Match The Shapes. Aim to clear the board using few moves, since extra slides cost points. Work through twenty-four different layouts.

pages.title: Connect Me
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Move and rotate tiles to connect them in Connect Me. Work out where each piece belongs and how it has to face, then test your reasoning across fifty levels.

pages.title: Scary Maze
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Guide the cursor through the narrow paths in Scary Maze. Keep it away from the walls and slow down at tight corners so you can make it to the end.

pages.title: Car Racing in Fast Highway Traffic
pages.creator: chipchop
pages.description: Race through highway traffic in Car Racing in Fast Highway Traffic. Watch for room between cars and try the road in daylight, at night, and in rainy conditions.

pages.title: Cowboy VS Zombie Attack
pages.creator: Lunar
pages.description: Take out zombies to build your score in Cowboy VS Zombie Attack. Watch for the next threat and keep fighting as more of the undead come into range.

pages.title: Gully Baseball
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Use a baseball to break windows in Gully Baseball. Time your swings with the mouse and try to smash more windows than the opponent before the match ends.

pages.title: Rabbit Punch
pages.creator: TD2TL
pages.description: Punch more rabbits than your rival in Rabbit Punch. Watch your side of the arcade round and react as the rabbits appear, then compare scores with the other player.

pages.title: GYM Toss
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Launch a friend into the air in GYM Toss. Watch the descent and time the next throw to send them higher as you try to improve the height of the toss.

pages.title: Desert Drone
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Fly a drone between rocks in Desert Drone. Use A and D or the arrow keys to steer, and try the three types of drone as you practice finding gaps.

pages.title: Pokey Ball Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Launch a ball upward in Pokey Ball Online. Aim for the center of a target to jump higher, get around obstacles, and reach the box at the top.

pages.title: Christmas Photo Differences 2
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Compare pairs of festive pictures in Christmas Photo Differences 2. Find the five changes that distinguish each pair, then move on to a new holiday scene.

pages.title: Fidget Spinner Xtreme Racing
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Steer a fidget spinner through a racing course in Fidget Spinner Xtreme Racing. Use the arrow keys and react as the speed increases, then try other spinner designs from the shop.

pages.title: KrisMas Tiles
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear groups of matching holiday tiles in KrisMas Tiles. Click a group to collect presents, and use a Krismas Bomb if you need help clearing the layout.

pages.title: Mr Ninja Fighter
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Take a sword-wielding ninja into action in Mr Ninja Fighter. Use the mouse and time your moves around enemies so you can get within striking distance and land a hit.

pages.title: BTS Christmas Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a festive illustration in BTS Christmas Coloring Book. Pick your own colors to fill in the design and try a different palette when you move to another picture.

pages.title: No Mercy Zombie City
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Fight back against the undead in No Mercy Zombie City. Guide a volunteer soldier through a city overrun at night and take out zombies as they close in.

pages.title: Candy Burst
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Use the single-click control in Candy Burst to release sweets and fill the container. Watch how the pieces pile up and decide when to stop before they spill.

pages.title: Zombie vs Warriors
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Fight monsters by matching tiles in Zombie vs Warriors. Match swords for the knight, hammers for the Viking, and vials or shields to heal or block when you need them.

pages.title: Dominoes
pages.creator: PlayJoy Games
pages.description: Take turns playing numbered tiles in Dominoes. Match the numbers on the open ends and try to empty your hand first so you can score the tiles your opponents still hold.

pages.title: Flappy Superhero Dunk
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Click or tap to bounce upward in Flappy Superhero Dunk. Get a clean dunk for extra points and keep scoring until you have enough to unlock more superheroes.

pages.title: Count The Llamas
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Count passing animals in Count The Llamas. Watch them go by one at a time and keep track as they start to yawn in this simple bedtime-themed activity.

pages.title: Dino Car Race
pages.creator: AdoLuxGames
pages.description: Race a sports car through back roads in Dino Car Race. Pass other drivers and steer around dinosaurs and obstacles that could slow you down before the finish.

pages.title: Endless Jump
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Leap from mushroom to mushroom in Endless Jump. Judge the distance before each attempt and keep landing on the next platform as you work toward a longer run.

pages.title: Space Attack Chicken Invaders
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Fly through enemy formations in Space Attack Chicken Invaders. Watch how each group moves, then fire through the openings and steer away from the incoming attacks.

pages.title: 2048 Cards
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Combine cards by value in 2048 Cards. Arrange matching numbers so they can merge into a higher one, and keep the playing area open for the next card.

pages.title: Wild Animals Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Rebuild pictures of wildlife in Wild Animals Jigsaw. Choose one of five images and decide whether to solve it with 25, 49, or 100 pieces.

pages.title: Fishing Game
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Catch fish with a penguin in Fishing Game. Use the mouse, try both fishing modes, and see which species you can add to the catch catalogue.

pages.title: Water Lab
pages.creator: PixelMaskGames
pages.description: Measure liquid using cups of different sizes in Water Lab. Work toward the target amount and keep track of which cups can hold each color when the levels get more complex.

pages.title: Crossy Zombie
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Guide your character past zombies in Crossy Zombie. Use the mouse to move through the route, and wait for a gap when the undead block the way ahead.

pages.title: Stairs Jump
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Bounce a ball up the steps in Stairs Jump. Watch the obstacles ahead, collect power-ups, and try to climb farther. Use the ball skins to give the next run a different look.

pages.title: Memory Match Jungle Animals
pages.creator: Miau Studio Entertainment
pages.description: Find pairs of jungle creatures in Memory Match Jungle Animals. Remember which animals appeared on each turn and use those positions to clear the rest of the cards.

pages.title: Stickman Fighter Training Camp
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Strike an endless iron column in Stickman Fighter Training Camp. Keep your timing steady as you train the fighter and see how high you can move up the leaderboard.

pages.title: EG Birds Coloring
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Choose a bird drawing in EG Birds Coloring. Add the colors you want to its feathers and surroundings, or pick a sheet to print for coloring on paper.

pages.title: Speed Racer
pages.creator: YAKPI
pages.description: Build speed on the road in Speed Racer. Watch the car as the track moves and see how long you can keep driving as the pace increases.

pages.title: Fashion Street Dance
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Dress two competitors in Fashion Street Dance. Pick clothes that work together for each dancer and give them distinct looks before the street dance contest.

pages.title: Klondike solitaire!
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Build suit piles from ace through king in Klondike solitaire! Rearrange descending stacks in alternating colors to reveal cards and free up moves on the board.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect 3d
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Rotate the board in Mahjong Connect 3d to see tiles from different sides. Find two matching pieces you can connect and remove them until the fairy's layout is clear.

pages.title: First Day At College
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Help Anna and Moana on their First Day At College. Search for the hidden objects the older students ask for, then get the two princesses ready for class.

pages.title: Monsterland. Junior vs Senior [Deluxe]
pages.creator: ALMA Games
pages.description: Clear blocks so Junior can reach his father in Monsterland. Junior vs Senior [Deluxe]. Think about which supports to remove and how the remaining pieces will fall.

pages.title: Pipe Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Turn segments to connect the whole network in Pipe Challenge. Click each pipe to change its direction and look for ends that still need to meet before moving on.

pages.title: Ellie Pro Photographer
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Set up a room for a portfolio shoot in Ellie Pro Photographer. Pick furnishings such as a bed and rug, take the photo, and see how many likes it gets.

pages.title: Find My Toys
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Look for Emma's missing playthings in Find My Toys. Search places such as the park and mall and check what is hiding among the other objects in each scene.

pages.title: NextRealm HexSweep
pages.creator: Next Realm Games
pages.description: Claim territory on a shared minefield in NextRealm HexSweep. Use the numbers on revealed hexes to locate mines, mark them, and expand before other players take the space.

pages.title: Princess Shopping Online
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Buy dresses for Rapunzel in Princess Shopping Online. Add them to her wardrobe, then try them with shoes and accessories to build different looks.

pages.title: Penalty Shootout: Euro Cup 2016
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Pick a national team in Penalty Shootout: Euro Cup 2016. Line up kicks when you're shooting and watch the goal when it's your turn to defend.

pages.title: Eggs and Cars
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Drive with a fragile passenger in Eggs and Cars. Adjust your speed over steep hills and try to reach the finish with the egg still on the backseat.

pages.title: Park My Car 2
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Find the correct spot for each car in Park My Car 2. Work out how to approach each space and move the cars without blocking the route you still need.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Sort the cards in Spider Solitaire 2 into runs from king down to ace. Move cards between columns to uncover the ones underneath and finish complete sequences.

pages.title: Princess College Fashion
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Style three college friends in Princess College Fashion. Choose tops, bottoms, and hairstyles for each one and see how the three looks work together.
